# me.poupe

> me.poupe is a personal finance web app for manual financial control. It helps users manage accounts, cards, invoices, budgets, notes, reports, attachments, and AI-generated insights. The product UI is in Brazilian Portuguese, the codebase uses English folder and import names. It runs as a web app/PWA — no native app is required.
>
> **Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Better Auth, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui. Package manager: pnpm. Linter: Biome.

me.poupe can be self-hosted by the user on their own machine or server.
There is no Open Finance or automatic bank synchronization.
Transactions can be entered manually or imported from OFX, CSV and XLS/XLSX files.
Attachments are optional and require S3-compatible storage.
The public website is mainly a landing page describing the product.
